verdict: The source is technically native 2D and correctly independent from B3A visible ownership, but visually fails the canonical body-source gate and the procedural-mannequin kill switch.
visual_failures: grossly oversized torso relative to head and legs
generic mannequin anatomy rather than Exilada-compatible lean resilient proportions
blocky hands and feet with poor anatomical readability at native 1x
pelvis and thigh transition reads as assembled primitives rather than coherent anatomy
high-contrast palette banding exaggerates a pseudo-3D mannequin appearance
neutral pose and silhouette are stiff and unsuitable as a convincing production body source
character identity is absent beyond generic adult-female markers
overall result does not read as intentional modern pixel-art character art
